  • (a) In general, all of P, K, S and Zn fertilizers should be applied as basal during final land preparation. S and Zn can be top-dressed if needed.
  • (b) For light textured soils, half of K should be applied as basal and the rest half should be applied with last N top-dressing.
  • (c) N should be applied in three equal splits, the first one as basal/immediately after seedling establishment, the second one at early tillering stage and the third one at 5-7 days before panicle initiation (PI) stage. 
  • (d) If using granular urea as a source of nitrogen fertilizer, 10-15 days after transplanting of Boro rice seedlings, 2.7 gm pellets of urea fertilizer are placed 7-10 cm (3-4 inches) below the soil in the middle of four hills and covered. Granular urea should be placed first between the 1st and 2nd rows of the rice field and then between the 3rd and 4th rows respectively.
  • (e) Seedlings in rice crops must be planted in rows at a distance of 20 cm (8 inches) from hill to hill and 20 cm (8 inches) from plant to plant.
  • (f) Using granular urea in paddy field requires about 25-30 percent less urea and 15-20 percent increase in yield.
